## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Validation

- [ ] Relevant tests pass, or I explain what could not run.
- [ ] I identify platforms personally tested and any CI-only validation.
- [ ] Documentation reflects changed behavior.
- [ ] New dependencies, copied code and assets have compatible licenses and required notices.
- [ ] My contributed commits include `Signed-off-by:` DCO lines.
